input.creator_request: Make it 20 seconds. Title: "This kid is climbing a tower made of people." Story edit in 6 chapters at a quick pace with high energy, day shots first and night shots last. Use every uploaded file, in this chapter order, and show each chapter line on screen word for word. Chapter 5 · fireworks in the night sky beside a lit tower · 4 seconds · It's La Mercè, Barcelona's biggest festival. Every September. Chapter 6 · white sparks shooting up, close · 2 seconds · Would you run through the fire?
